picks.title: I found a speech recognition model hiding inside VS Code, and it never sends a word to the cloud

picks.rationale: Apple put a price tag on an on-device AI feature — $9.99/month for one camera's motion summaries, $59.99 for five. The clearest signal yet of how AI capability gets metered inside hardware you already bought.
picks.excerpt: Apple is requiring a $9.99 iCloud+ plan to use the iOS 27 Apple Intelligence Home app features with a single HomeKit camera, and iPhone users aren't happy about it. iOS 27 includes text-based descriptions for motion alerts, a feature that uses Apple Intelligence. It recognizes people, animals, vehicles, packages, and general motion, and summarizes what's happening.
picks.title: iOS 27 AI Camera Summaries Cost $9.99 for One Camera, $59.99 for Five
